name: Thunder Tube - Basic Edition
shortDescription: The Thunder Tube is a unique musical instrument that produces a thundering sound effect. It consists of a metal tube with a spring attached to it and a plastic membrane at one end. The tube is held vertically and shaken, causing the spring to vibrate against the membrane, creating a sound resembling thunder. The Thunder Tube is a versatile instrument that can be used in various musical contexts. Our Thunder tubes are handmade and come in a range of designs with vibrant dot paints on the surface of the tube. This thunder tube creates fun, storm-like sounds and is great for casual use or introductory sound play. It has a more basic tonal quality and may not suit the needs of professional sound therapists or healers. Our Thunder tubes comes in 3 sizes viz 20cms, 25cms and 30cms.

name: Mini Coconut Shakers - 3 Types
shortDescription:
The Mini Coconut Shaker is a handheld percussion instrument made from natural coconut shells. The Mini Coconut Shaker is created by fusing together hollow coconut shells filled with dried beans that create the percussive shaking rattle sound as they collide with each other and the inside surface of the shaker. This instrument is hand-crafted in India by skilled artisans who have been doing this for generations.   We have a range of coconut shakers that produce distinct sounds based on their shapes and sizes. These include
  • Mini Square Shaker
  • Mini Round Shaker
  • Mini Eye Shaker
